newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.00 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.00 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.67788 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.97 percent at the previous tender on November 5.
Bids for the HK$1 billion issue totalled HK$3.08 billion. At the previous tender, bids for the HK$800 million issue amounted to HK$4.33 billion.

The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 4.90 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.53365 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.93 percent at the previous tender on November 12.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue fell to HK$9.82 billion from HK$14.17 billion.
